text: {"name":"btm_get_indirect_table","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Propagates a shared indirect value through active linked-list descriptors, stops at the terminal flag pattern, and returns the shared 16-bit table, trapping if its first element is negative and the list ends early.","subsystem":"bt","var_renames":{"v1":"indirect_descriptor","v2":"indirect_value","v3":"entry","v4":"entry_flags"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"Next entry in the linked list"},{"offset":36,"meaning":"Entry flags; mask 0x380000 is checked for the terminal pattern"},{"offset":76,"meaning":"Pointer to the entry's indirect descriptor"},{"offset":28,"meaning":"Descriptor state or validity field; nonzero enables processing"},{"offset":32,"meaning":"Descriptor base pointer used to derive the indirect write target"}]}
